SELECT u.secret_key_hash, i.media_type, (
     COALESCE(u.profile_image_id = i.id, $2)
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT $3 FROM posts p
       WHERE p.image_id = i.id AND p.author_id = u.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
     )
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT $4 FROM realmojis r
       JOIN posts p ON p.id = r.post_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
       JOIN users author ON author.id = p.author_id AND author.status = $5
       WHERE r.image_id = i.id AND r.reactor_id = u.id AND r.replaced_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
     )
   ) AS visible
   FROM image_object_locations l
   JOIN image_objects i ON i.id = l.id AND i.created_at = l.created_at
   JOIN users u ON u.id = i.owner_user_id
   WHERE l.id = $1 AND u.status = $6

  FROM posts p

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.author_id, p.posting_window_id, p.image_id, p.caption, p.visibility,
         p.location_kind, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.locality, p.posted_at,
         w.on_time_deadline, w.ended_at AS window_ended_at,
         u.id AS "author.id", u.username AS "author.username", u.secret_key_hash AS "author.secret_key_hash", u.display_name AS "author.display_name", u.bio AS "author.bio", u.profile_image_id AS "author.profile_image_id", u.region AS "author.region", u.account_type AS "author.account_type", u.status AS "author.status"
  FROM posts p
  JOIN posting_windows w ON w.id = p.posting_window_id
  JOIN users u ON u.id = p.author_id AND u.status = $11
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND w.ended_at IS NULL AND u.status = $12 AND p.author_id <> $1 AND NOT (p.author_id = ANY($4::text[])) AND COALESCE($2::text[], $13::text[]) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE($3::text[], $14::text[]) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE($5::text[], $15::text[]) IS NOT NULL AND p.author_id = ANY($3::text[]) AND NOT (p.author_id = ANY($2::text[])) AND p.visibility IN ($16, $17)),
mutual_friends AS (
  SELECT * FROM unnest($6::text[], $7::int[]) AS m(user_id, cnt)
),
connections AS (
  SELECT ca.author_id, sum(mf.cnt)::bigint AS cnt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_id FROM candidates) ca
  JOIN friendships f ON ca.author_id IN (f.user_low_id, f.user_high_id)
  JOIN mutual_friends mf ON mf.user_id = CASE
    WHEN f.user_low_id = ca.author_id THEN f.user_high_id
    ELSE f.user_low_id
  END
  GROUP BY ca.author_id
),
friend_engagements AS (
  SELECT e.post_id, count(*)::bigint AS cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT r.post_id, r.reactor_id AS user_id
    FROM realmojis r
    JOIN users ru ON ru.id = r.reactor_id AND ru.status = $18
    WHERE r.replaced_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND r.post_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
    UNION
    SELECT c.post_id, c.author_id
    FROM comments c
    JOIN users cu ON cu.id = c.author_id AND cu.status = $19
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.post_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
  ) e
  JOIN unnest($2::text[]) AS fr(user_id) ON fr.user_id = e.user_id
  GROUP BY e.post_id
),
scored AS (
  SELECT c.*,
         $20 * COALESCE(fe.cnt, $21) + $22 * COALESCE(mf.cnt, $23) + LEAST(COALESCE(conn.cnt, $24), $25) AS score
  FROM candidates c
  LEFT JOIN mutual_friends mf ON mf.user_id = c.author_id
  LEFT JOIN connections conn ON conn.author_id = c.author_id
  LEFT JOIN friend_engagements fe ON fe.post_id = c.id
)
SELECT *
FROM scored
WHERE ($8::bigint IS NULL OR (score, posted_at, id) < ($8, $9, $10))
ORDER BY score DESC, posted_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT
  s.calls AS cnt,
  s.total_exec_time AS sum,
  s.min_exec_time AS min,
  s.mean_exec_time AS avg,
  s.max_exec_time AS max,
  s.rows AS sumRows,
  COALESCE((s.rows / NULLIF(s.calls,$1)),$2) AS avgRows,
  d.datname AS db,
  s.query
FROM pg_stat_statements s
LEFT JOIN pg_database d ON s.dbid = d.oid
ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC

SELECT relations.id, relations.updated_at, u.id AS "user.id", u.username AS "user.username", u.secret_key_hash AS "user.secret_key_hash", u.display_name AS "user.display_name", u.bio AS "user.bio", u.profile_image_id AS "user.profile_image_id", u.region AS "user.region", u.account_type AS "user.account_type", u.status AS "user.status"
   FROM (SELECT id, requester_id AS first_id, recipient_id AS second_id, updated_at FROM friend_requests WHERE requester_id=$1 AND status=$4) relations
   JOIN users u ON u.status = $5
               AND u.id = CASE WHEN relations.first_id = $1 THEN relations.second_id ELSE relations.first_id END
   WHERE ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR (relations.updated_at, relations.id) < ($2, $3))
